body:
## Why (verified evidence)

`docs/LABELS.md` makes `agent:auto` beside one concrete `agent:<name>` label the contract, and since 2026-09-22 the opener lane applies that pair to every PR it creates. Only keepalive honors the pair: `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js:2621-2637` drops the concrete label before calling the shared resolver. Every other caller passes the raw labels to a resolver that throws on the pair, then falls back to a default. A Claude-opened PR is therefore attributed to codex by the verifier and its follow-ups.

Verified on `main` at f0b58fc:

- `.github/scripts/agent_registry.js:316-318` throws `Multiple agent labels present: auto, <x>` when `agent:auto` meets one concrete label. `.github/scripts/__tests__/agent-registry.test.js:110-120` pins that rejection.
- `.github/workflows/reusable-agents-verifier.yml:394-417` catches the throw, warns, and uses the registry default agent. :419-423 then emits `agent_key`, `agent:<default>` and `from:<default>` for the PR.
- `.github/workflows/agents-verify-to-new-pr.yml:899-911` has the same fallback for the follow-up PR's agent label.
- `.github/workflows/agents-autofix-loop.yml:478-486` falls back to `routingAgentKeys[0]`, and `auto` is not in `nonRoutingAgentKeys` (:424). The REST API returns labels in label-ID order, so the fallback is `auto` in any repo whose `agent:auto` label was created before its concrete label. The loop then stops with `unsupported agent type for autofix loop: auto` (:731-737). In stranske/Workflows the concrete labels are older, so today it picks the concrete agent, but only by accident of label creation order.
- `.github/scripts/bot-comment-handler.js:359-378` falls back to `legacyAgentRoute`, a fixed claude, then gemini, then codex precedence.

## Tasks

- [ ] `.github/scripts/agent_registry.js:316-318`: when `agent:auto` is present with exactly one concrete label, return `{ mode: 'auto', agentKey: <that concrete agent>, requested: 'auto' }` instead of throwing. Two or more concrete labels still throw (:313-315).
- [ ] `.github/scripts/__tests__/agent-registry.test.js:110-120`: replace the rejection test with the named tests below.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/agents-autofix-loop.yml:424`: add `'auto'` to `nonRoutingAgentKeys`, so the fallback can never select it.
- [ ] Copy `.github/scripts/agent_registry.js` byte-for-byte to `templates/consumer-repo/.github/scripts/agent_registry.js`.
- [ ] `docs/LABELS.md` and `templates/consumer-repo/docs/LABELS.md`, `agent:auto` section: delete the sentence beginning "Only keepalive routing honors the pair today", which #3516 added to record this gap.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Named test `resolveAgentRoutingFromLabels keeps the concrete agent beside agent:auto` in `.github/scripts/__tests__/agent-registry.test.js`: `['agent:auto', 'agent:claude']` returns mode `auto`, agentKey `claude`, requested `auto`.
- Named test `resolveAgentRoutingFromLabels still rejects two concrete agents beside agent:auto`, in the same file: `['agent:auto', 'agent:codex', 'agent:claude']` throws `Multiple agent labels present`.
- Named test `test_autofix_fallback_never_selects_auto`, in a new `tests/workflows/test_autofix_loop_routing.py`: asserts the `nonRoutingAgentKeys` set in `.github/workflows/agents-autofix-loop.yml` contains `'auto'`.
- `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/*.test.js` passes.
- `python -m pytest tests/workflows tests/docs -q` passes.
- `diff .github/scripts/agent_registry.js templates/consumer-repo/.github/scripts/agent_registry.js` prints nothing.
- Deliberate-break then revert: restore the throw at :316-318. `resolveAgentRoutingFromLabels keeps the concrete agent beside agent:auto` must FAIL. Revert and it passes.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT change the keepalive label filter at `keepalive_loop.js:2621-2637`, or `decideNextAgent`. Initial selection is #3517, and the provider flags are #3392.
- Do NOT change how two concrete labels are handled. They remain an error.
- No scaffolding or TODO-only changes. Every task is a concrete edit verified by the gate above.

_Surfaced by the Codex review of #3516 (P1 there) and verified by reading `main`. Filed as P2 because the effect is misattribution in the verifier and follow-up routing, not a stalled PR: keepalive itself routes correctly._
title: [P2] resolveAgentRoutingFromLabels rejects agent:auto beside a concrete label, so the verifier and follow-ups fall back to the default agent
